releaseNotes: v5.1.2 — Screenshot Reader is now its own tab: a big drop box (upload, drag & drop, or paste with Ctrl+V), and you choose where the data goes (Save as trades, Fill an account, or Both). The Windows screenshot-read crash is fixed, the desktop icon is the new XAUUSD logo (new icon file, so Windows shows it at once), and updates now check GitHub Releases first (Drive stays only as a backup) with a real browser User-Agent. Everything from v5.1 kept: OCR reader, voice comments in 4 modes, multi-account, 12 themes, live price.
